All about the product

All from your phone.

The diffuser connects to your home Wi-Fi and follows the schedule you set.

Description

Eucalyptus & Sage is a green, aromatic fragrance, made for the hours when you need to focus. One capsule, one scent: fresh notes that never overpower.

The diffuser cold-mists the fragrance, with no water and no heat.
